_about: Generic displacement unit pieces for SUBSIDE. The H2I job emits land_surface__displacement in metres and a consumer may want millimetres (or vice versa); both share one standard variable, so these let the planner bridge the unit. Factors live in app/task_code.py (_FACTORS for the function body, _unit_factor_for_step for the pipeline-tail marker).

transform_specs.name: displacement-m-to-mm
transform_specs.description: Convert a land-surface displacement raster from metres to millimetres.

transform_specs.name: displacement-mm-to-m
transform_specs.description: Convert a land-surface displacement raster from millimetres to metres.
